journey.name: app status emergency exit
journey.description:
While an emergency exit is active, App Status shows an "Emergency Exit" row under Lightning Connection. It reads "Fee funding needed" while the exit asks for fee funding and "In progress" otherwise, including while a payment that covers the funding waits to confirm. The row opens the exit's progress screen, and leaving that screen returns to App Status. With no active exit the row is absent.
Precondition: dev build on regtest with Spark connected and an emergency exit started but not yet funded (spark emergency exit journey, then swipe to start the exit with "Fund from another wallet"). Start on the wallet home screen. Starting an exit takes the Spark balance out of Spending for days, so use a throwaway wallet.

actions.action: Tap the menu button (testTag "HeaderMenu") and tap App Status (testTag "DrawerAppStatus")
Verify a row titled "Emergency Exit" (testTag "Status-spark_exit") sits under Lightning Connection (testTag "Status-lightning_connection") and reads "Fee funding needed"
Tap the row and verify the exit's progress screen (testTag "SparkExitProgress") opens
Tap "Cancel exit", confirm, and verify "Exit cancelled" shows
Tap "OK" (testTag "SparkExitProgressOk") and verify App Status shows again, now without the "Emergency Exit" row
